controls.name: Line1
controls.caption: The company that you are importing data to is missing some information. Without it, the migration will contain errors that you will have to fix later.

controls.name: CurrentPeriod
controls.caption: Current Period
controls.tooltip: Specifies the start date of the current accounting period. Transactions after this date are migrated individually. Transactions before this date are aggregated per account, and migrated as a single amount.

controls.name: LocalCurrencyCode
controls.caption: Local Currency Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the currency code for your company.

controls.name: Get Periods Enpdoint
controls.tooltip: Specifies the url of endpoint for "Get VAT Periods" service.

controls.name: Submit VAT Return Endpoint
controls.tooltip: Specifies the url of endpoint for "Send VAT Return" service.

controls.name: Check Status Endpoint
controls.tooltip: Specifies the url of endpoint for "Check VAT Return status" service.

controls.name: Client Certificate Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code of client-side certificate which is used to sign the requests to service.

controls.name: Server Certificate Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code of server-side certificate which is used to validate the responses from service.

controls.name: ERP See Number
controls.tooltip: Specifies the SEE number used to report the VAT Return to service.

controls.name: Use Azure Key Vault
controls.tooltip: Specifies whether to use Azure Key Vault to store the certificates and endpoints.

controls.name: No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the communication with Skat.dk.

controls.name: Transaction ID
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unique ID for the transaction.

controls.name: Request Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of the request.

controls.name: Related VAT Return No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the VAT Return that is related to the communication with Skat.dk.

controls.name: TimeSent
controls.tooltip: Specifies the time when the request was sent.

controls.name: Response Transaction ID
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unique ID of the response transaction.

actions.name: DownloadRequestBLOB
actions.caption: Download Request
actions.tooltip: Download the XML Request which was sent to SKAT.DK

actions.name: DownloadResponseBLOB
actions.caption: Download Response
actions.tooltip: Download the XML Response which was received from SKAT.DK

controls.name: Payroll Trans. Import Format

controls.name: OIOUBL-Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code for the Offentlig Information Online UBL (OIOUBL) profile.

controls.name: OIOUBL-Profile ID
controls.tooltip: Specifies the available profile IDs that can be used for electronic invoicing of the public sector in Denmark.

controls.name: OIOUBL-Invoice Path
controls.tooltip: Specifies the path and name of the folder where you want to store the files for electronic invoices.

controls.name: OIOUBL-Cr. Memo Path
controls.tooltip: Specifies the path and name of the folder where you want to store the files for electronic credit memos.

controls.name: OIOUBL-Reminder Path
controls.tooltip: Specifies the path and name of the folder where you want to store the files for electronic reminders.

controls.name: OIOUBL-Fin. Chrg. Memo Path
controls.tooltip: Specifies the path and name of the folder where you want to store the files for electronic finance charge memos.

controls.name: OIOUBL-Default Profile Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the default profile that you use in the electronic documents that you send to customers in the Danish public sector.

controls.name: OIOUBL-VAT Registration No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the company's VAT registration number.

controls.name: Name
controls.tooltip: Specifies the company's name and corporate form such as Aps. or A/S.

controls.name: City

controls.name: OIOUBL-Post Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the postal code.
